description: Check a certificate, or a whole certificate wallet, that a worker shared from Jobsite as a link (https://jobsitecerts.com/w/…). Returns the holder's name, each credential with its issuer, issue and expiry dates, current status (current, expiring soon, expired or revoked), and its basis: earned in Jobsite training, an outside credential the employer recorded, or an employer record Jobsite has not verified. Only works with a link the worker made; it never looks a person up by name, and an expired or revoked link returns not found.

link.description: The share link the worker gave you, or the 43-character code at its end.

name: verify_certificate
title: Check a worker's shared certificate
